summary: IMM 5708, “Application to Change Conditions, Extend my Stay or Remain in Canada as a Visitor or Temporary Resident Permit Holder”, is the form from Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) that people already in Canada use to stay longer as a visitor (a visitor record), restore their visitor status, or get a temporary resident permit. Each person applying fills in their own, and most upload it in their IRCC secure account.
